contract: Run real CIFAR-10 with 16 class-wise Dirichlet(alpha=0.5) clients through the exact queued uniform-resampling path for one D=4 seed. Exercise vanilla and clipped gradients, record accuracy curves and first-hit times, and reject an untrained-model target control.
accepted_scope: Calibration only: one seed, selected hyperparameters, 3,200 rather than 8,000 time units.
